metadata.title: Secure Storage Relying Systems SSPP
metadata.remarks: Defines mandatory behavioral and integration constraints for systems that rely on secure storage services. This SSPP ensures consuming systems do not weaken, bypass, or undermine secure storage security guarantees.

import-profile.remarks: Relying system obligations derive from all secure storage SSPPs and SHALL NOT reimplement or override platform-level security guarantees.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines how applications, services, pipelines, and automation must interact with secure storage systems.

system-implementation.remarks: Systems consuming secure storage SHALL rely on platform-enforced security guarantees and SHALL NOT attempt to compensate for, bypass, or reimplement storage security controls.

components.description: Interfaces through which applications and services read from and write to secure storage.
Application logic and automation that interacts with secure storage services.

roles.title: Secure Storage Relying Architecture
roles.remarks: Designs integration patterns that correctly consume secure storage services without weakening platform guarantees.

roles.title: Secure Storage Relying Oversight
roles.remarks: Verifies that relying systems use secure storage correctly and do not introduce security drift.

relying-system-requirements.statement: Relying systems SHALL use secure storage services as provided and SHALL NOT implement alternative or compensating storage security mechanisms.
Relying systems SHALL NOT offload encryption, integrity, immutability, or lifecycle enforcement to application logic.
Relying systems SHALL respect retention, legal hold, and immutability constraints enforced by the storage platform.
Relying systems SHALL access secure storage using their own dedicated identities and SHALL NOT share credentials or access tokens.

prohibited-relying-actions.statement: Relying systems SHALL NOT access storage backends through unmanaged or undocumented paths.
Relying systems SHALL NOT request or assume privileged storage roles beyond their authorized scope.
Relying systems SHALL NOT attempt to bypass retention, immutability, or destruction controls.
Relying systems SHALL NOT suppress, filter, or alter storage-generated telemetry.

escalation-requirements.statement: Detected misuse or attempted bypass of secure storage by relying systems SHALL escalate in accordance with the Secure Storage Violation & Drift SSPP.

control-implementation.description: Relying system controls ensure secure storage is consumed without weakening platform guarantees.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least-privilege access is enforced for relying systems.
Security architecture dependencies are preserved across system boundaries.
Relying systems operate only with necessary functionality.

statements.statement: Relying systems SHALL trust and consume storage security guarantees rather than reimplement them.
Relying systems SHALL NOT become de facto storage security authorities.
Misuse of secure storage SHALL be treated as a security violation.

back-matter.remarks: All systems relying on secure storage services SHALL conform to this SSPP. Environment-specific overlays MAY further constrain behavior but SHALL NOT weaken these requirements.
